title: The same request during a Wi-Fi outage
commands: python -m helpdesk.cli --user demo-user-a --thread s07 --profile wifi_outage --message "I enabled Wi-Fi and forgot the saved network, but Campus-Demo still will not connect. Check whether Wi-Fi is down. If it is operating, prepare a ticket about this problem."

turns.user_message: I enabled Wi-Fi and forgot the saved network, but Campus-Demo still will not connect. Check whether Wi-Fi is down. If it is operating, prepare a ticket about this problem.

result.message: The demo Wi-Fi service is unavailable across campus. The fixture gives no repair time.

result.title: Connect to the practice campus network
steps: Check that Wi-Fi is enabled and airplane mode is off.
If connection fails, forget the saved network and try connecting again.
If the problem remains, check the service status before preparing a ticket.

events.model_answer:
Wi-Fi is currently experiencing a campus-wide outage. No repair time is available.

Because the service is down, I did not prepare a ticket. You can try connecting to **Campus-Demo** again after the outage is resolved.
